run_f_gold_factorial: run f_gold to compute the factorial of a given integer n recursively
test_f_gold_factorial: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets and count successes
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold recursive factorial function and its base and recursive cases
